You grade phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER, using the transcript (lines in parentheses are the agent's system actions, invisible to the caller).
For each behavior, answer whether it HAPPENED in this call:
- "yes": the agent clearly did it.
- "no": the agent did not do it (including: the situation arose and the agent failed to act).
- "n/a": the situation the behavior depends on never arose (e.g. "repeats more slowly when asked" and the caller never asked).
Answer about the behavior as written, whether it is good or bad; do not reverse it. Be strict and literal. Cite the most relevant agent turn [#N], or null.
Reply with JSON only: {"<id>": {"verdict": "yes"|"no"|"n/a", "turn": N|null, "why": "<at most 25 words>"}, ...}

SCENARIO CONTEXT: Transfer sertraline only from B-4471 to H-302; treat Zoloft = sertraline; resolve the old store via phone/city/profile without interrogating him; one final read-back.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hey, Jamal Carter, 3/14/95. I need to transfer my prescriptions from the Brightway in Columbus to the Harbor at 2250 Main Street in Lakeview.
    (agent system action #2: verify_identity({"patient":"Jamal Carter","dob":"3/14/1995"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Jamal Carter","home_store":"H-302","default_store":"H-302","authorized_contacts":[],"restricted_contacts":[]})
    (agent system action #5: find_stores({"query":"Harbor 2250 Main Street Lakeview"}) -> success {"stores":[{"store_id":"H-302","name":"Harbor Pharmacy Main St University","address":"2250 Main St, Lakeview, MI (near Oak St)"}]})
    (agent system action #7: list_prescriptions({"patient":"Jamal Carter"}) -> success {"patient":"Jamal Carter","prescriptions":[]})
[#9] AGENT: I'll help you transfer your prescriptions. Let me verify your identity first, and then I'll look up your prescriptions and the Lakeview store. Good news—you're already set up at the Harbor on Main Street in Lakeview, and that's your home store. But I'm not seeing any active prescriptions in our system right now. Do you have prescriptions at Brightway that you'd like us to request, or are your prescriptions already here?
CALLER: Yeah, at Brightway in Columbus - albuterol and... Zoloft.
[#12] AGENT: Got it. I'll need to request those from Brightway since they're at another pharmacy chain. Let me confirm the details: you want us to request your albuterol and Zoloft from the Brightway in Columbus to come here to Harbor at 2250 Main Street in Lakeview, right?
CALLER: Yeah exactly. The sertraline, same thing as the Zoloft.
    (agent system action #15: transfer_rx({"rx":"albuterol","from_store":"Brightway Columbus","to_store":"H-302"}) -> error:unknown_store {"error":"unknown_store","message":"Unknown from_store or to_store id."})
    (agent system action #17: transfer_rx({"rx":"sertraline","from_store":"Brightway Columbus","to_store":"H-302"}) -> error:unknown_store {"error":"unknown_store","message":"Unknown from_store or to_store id."})
[#19] AGENT: Perfect, I've got it—albuterol and sertraline from Brightway Columbus to here. Let me request those transfers for you. I need to get the store ID for Brightway in Columbus. Can you give me the address or any other details about that location?
CALLER: Oh wait, actually leave the inhaler at Brightway, I've still got one. Just do the sertraline.
[#22] AGENT: Got it, just the sertraline. I still need the Brightway Columbus store details to request the transfer. Do you have the address or phone number for that location?
CALLER: I don't know the address, it's the one in Columbus. Can't you just look it up?
[#25] AGENT: I can search for it, but I need a bit more to narrow it down—is there a street name or cross street you remember, or any landmark near that Brightway?
CALLER: Uh, I think it's on High Street? Pretty sure that's it.
    (agent system action #28: find_stores({"query":"Brightway Columbus High Street"}) -> success {"stores":[]})
[#30] AGENT: Perfect, let me search for that. I'm not finding a Brightway on High Street in Columbus in our system. Since Brightway is a different pharmacy chain, I can't look them up directly. Here's what we can do: you can call Brightway and ask them to transfer your sertraline to us here at Harbor on Main Street in Lakeview, or you can pick it up from them and bring the prescription in. Which works better for you?
CALLER: Ugh, okay, I'll just call them myself. Thanks anyway, bye.
(call ended: stop_condition)

BEHAVIORS:
S11.judged.1: Treats 'Zoloft' and 'sertraline' as the same single prescription.
S11.judged.2: Gives one final read-back: sertraline only, from B-4471 to H-302.
S11.judged.3: Makes Jamal look up or provide the old store's address.
S11.judged.4: Asks more than one question to identify the old store.
S11.judged.5: Re-asks name/DOB after he gave them.
S11.judged.6: Says or implies the 2250 Main St store has the medication in stock or will have it ready to pick up (moving the prescription record is fine; promising stock is not).

JSON only.
